index ffac5ce22e60816f18267d742455e4936b6d1c1a..fbb8a0743dbc9c300454fdd59e06315637304a51 100644
--- a/inflection/__init__.py
+++ b/inflection/__init__.py
@@ -370,14 +370,41 @@ def titleize(word: str) -> str:
       'The Man Without A Past'
       >>> titleize("raiders_of_the_lost_ark")
       'Raiders Of The Lost Ark'
+      >>> titleize("NASA rocket launch")
+      'NASA Rocket Launch'
+      >>> titleize("read the HTTP spec")
+      'Read The HTTP Spec'
+      >>> titleize("HELLO WORLD")
+      'Hello World'
+
+    All-caps words (acronyms such as ``NASA``) are kept as they are, but only
+    when the input also contains lowercase letters.
 
     """
-    return re.sub(
+    acronyms = []
+
+    def protect(match):
+        acronyms.append(match.group(0))
+        return "zzacronym{}zz".format(len(acronyms) - 1)
+
+    if any(char.islower() for char in word):
+        word = re.sub(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b", protect, word)
+
+    result = re.sub(
         r"\b('?\w)",
         lambda match: match.group(1).capitalize(),
         humanize(underscore(word)).title()
     )
 
+    for index, acronym in enumerate(acronyms):
+        result = re.sub(
+            r"zzacronym{}zz".format(index),
+            lambda match, acronym=acronym: acronym,
+            result,
+            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    return result
+
 
 def transliterate(string: str) -> str:
